name: Support
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; 13 of 44 local client repos ship some contact/support surface)
description: Inbound support. The contact variant is a spam-resistant public form that emails a mailbox. The ticketing variant keeps every submission as a ticket with status, assignment and a threaded reply history that emails the requester.

mode.prompt: How much support surface do you need?

contact.label: Contact form only — submissions are emailed, nothing is managed in-app

ticketing.label: Full ticketing — statuses, assignment and threaded replies
